evals.prompt: The user writes "any replies from the companies I applied to?" with no date. The project has jobs-writer and no jobs-applier folder next to the manager.
evals.expected_output: Files a jobs-writer card with skills [triaging-inbox], body 'Mode: INBOX' and the project path, key jobs:inbox:<project>:<today>; tells the user a list of proposed updates will come for approval. The manager reads no mail itself.

evals.prompt: The user says "I applied to Acme yesterday and they called me today for a screening" in Bot Chat.
evals.expected_output: Routes to tracking-outcomes; no card is filed by the manager for the status change itself. The outcome is recorded only through tracker.py update and status.py append after the user confirms the dates.

evals.prompt: The user writes "pause the search" and then pastes a job link in the same message.
evals.expected_output: profile.md gets search: paused and confirmed in one line, and a jobs-scout URL card is still filed for the pasted link, because pause stops only the scheduled search.
